signature.name: VTask.Stable
signature.type: {R : Type u_1} -> {M : Type u_2} -> [CommRing R] -> [AddCommGroup M] -> [Module R M] -> {I : Ideal R} -> (F : I.Filtration M) -> Prop

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: VTask.Stable is a Prop-valued predicate with no junk-value or boundary convention; it is simply true or false for any filtration, and no special values are assigned at degenerate inputs.

facts.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) (M : Type*) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (I : Ideal R) (F : I.Filtration M), VTask.Stable F ↔ ∃ n₀, ∀ n ≥ n₀, F.N n = I ^ (n - n₀) • F.N n₀

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ¬ (∀ (R : Type*) (M : Type*) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (I : Ideal R) (F : I.Filtration M), VTask.Stable F)

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.instance: Ideal.Filtration.mk (fun n => if n = 0 then ⊤ else ⊥) (by sorry) (by sorry)
facts.violated_property: Not every I-filtration is stable; stability is an additional condition requiring eventual I-multiplication behaviour.
